item.title: UK Watchdog Bans Coinbase Ads for Linking Crypto to Cost-of-Living Crisis
item.description: The UK’s advertising regulator has banned a high-profile marketing campaign by Coinbase, ruling that the ads irresponsibly implied cryptocurrency could help address the country’s cost-of-living pressures.
